delta.note: This is the third amendment to Perpres 82/2018 on Jaminan Kesehatan. It mainly introduces the standard inpatient class (KRIS), FKTP choice and transfer, PHK benefits, medical benefits, payment to facilities, and monitoring. It does not change BPJS Kesehatan contribution rates. The contribution ceiling of Rp12,000,000 is unchanged. The minimum wage floor is only restated, with UMP as the base and UMK where it is set. The amendment does exempt micro and small enterprises from that floor, but their own floor is left to a later actuarial study, so no new figure exists yet. Benefits, tariffs and contributions under KRIS are deferred to a later decision due by 1 July 2025. Nothing in the document changes the employer-paid health contribution included in a permanent employee's gross income, or any other PPh 21 calculation step.
